failure_summary.description: Returned a related material, process, measurement, place, or organ instead of the requested slot or a candidate satisfying all clue hints.
Used an unnecessarily extended company name or the wrong conventional number form.
Treated a cut-off quotation as a request to identify its source rather than supply the word that completes it.

patch.reasoning: Most errors are already covered by the skill's slot, evidence, and exact-form rules, so repeating them would add little. The quotation-completion case exposes a narrower gap: the prompt cues a missing continuation without using an ellipsis.

edits.target: - When an ellipsis marks omitted words in a title or phrase, use context to recover and return the missing continuation. Prefer a completion that fits the whole fragment over a prominent work or entity that matches only a shorter substring.
edits.content: - If a quoted line or phrase is cut off and the prompt asks what comes next (for example, by ending with “this”), treat it as a cloze: return the immediate missing word or phrase, not the source work’s title or author. Use the whole quoted fragment to resolve the continuation.
